title: Warm Crispy Egyptian Fruit Mix Fritters
description: Indulge in these crispy, yeasty Egyptian fritters filled with a mix of fruits, perfect for a sweet treat. This low-sodium-friendly dessert is a delightful twist on traditional Egyptian cuisine.

ingredients.name: mixed fruit
ingredients.notes: such as pineapple, apple, and orange

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, yeast, and sugar, whisking until well combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs, milk, and vanilla extract.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Gently fold in the mixed fruit.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Using a spoon, drop the batter into the hot oil, making sure not to overcrowd the pan.
Fry the fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and crispy.
Remove the fritters from the oil with a slotted spoon and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the fritters warm and enjoy.
